issues.explanation: Stray second block with return of casts array after membershipFor() is a PHP parse error, so User model cannot load.
Imports SoftDeletes trait from Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes instead of Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes, so Entity fails with trait-not-found.
Compares enum-cast role to UserRole::Owner->value string with === so the owner guard is always false and owner self-removal is allowed.
Compares enum-cast membership role to string values with in_array so owner/admin checks always fail and legitimate update/delete/assignRole are always denied.
SQLite path creates a plain INTEGER column maintained by triggers instead of the required stored generated owner_seq column, incorrectly claiming SQLite cannot do generated columns.
Diff adds no Pest/PHPUnit tests for models, factories, constraints, or policies despite TDD requiring tests for all new behavior.
Registers the same two policies in both AppServiceProvider via Gate::policy and a new AuthServiceProvider, creating redundant registration.
Duplicate use App\Models\UserRole import and use of fully-qualified policy/model names despite imports shows inconsistent sibling style.
Migration uses a named class plus raw DB::statement with two CREATE TRIGGER statements in one call, deviating from make:migration anonymous-class style and risking driver failure.
Misleading manageable() docblock says roles that can manage settings for an entity when manageSettings is owner-only per task.

conventions.evidence: No tests shipped (tdd violation); duplicate Gate::policy + new AuthServiceProvider; named migration class; docs/database-schema.md:34 correctly updated to remove owner_membership_id

readability.evidence: app/Models/User.php:58 stray block; app/Models/Entity.php:6 wrong SoftDeletes import; app/Models/EntityMembership.php:7 duplicate use; FQCN Gate::policy despite imports

requirements.evidence: app/Models/User.php:58 parse error; app/Models/Entity.php:6 wrong SoftDeletes trait so code cannot work; policies compare enum to UserRole::Owner->value string so always false; SQLite path uses triggers not stored generated owner_seq

scope.evidence: No routes/pages/session code added and docs update serves task; only redundancy is duplicate AppServiceProvider:34 + AuthServiceProvider:1 registration

security.evidence: app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:21 owner === string always false allows owner deletion via self-removal; app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:26 in_array(enum,[strings]) always denies legitimate writes

simplicity.evidence: Duplicate policy registration in two providers; duplicate use statements; trigger-maintenance workaround instead of one portable generated column

tests.evidence: No test files in change.diff; no Pest coverage for entities, memberships, one-owner constraint, or view/update/delete/manageSettings/assignRole paths

review.summary: Adds entities, memberships, roles, factories, policies and docs matching the task shape, but User.php has a parse error, Entity imports a nonexistent SoftDeletes trait, all enum role checks compare to strings so they always fail, and SQLite uses triggers instead of the required stored generated column. Owner-deletion protection is therefore bypassed, there are no tests, and policies are registered twice, so the change needs substantial rework before merging.
